deviations: memisc is not installed in the sandbox, so memisc 'item' columns (e.g. taxe_approbation, taxe_efficace, gilets_jaunes, diplome4, taille_agglo) and Hmisc 'labelled' classes were stripped to their underlying values: character items enter lm as factors, double items as numeric, and no values are recoded as missing. With this, the Table 4 column 1 sample is 757, the same as the paper.

The control-variable vectors (variables_reg_effect_feedback, variables_reg_self_interest, variables_reg_ee) are taken from after_papier.RData, where papier.R stored them; the data frame s comes from after_preparation.RData, as papier.R loads it.
notes: Follows papier.R exactly, using weighted lm. Table 4 columns 1-4 are reg_effect_feedback_1..4. Table 6 column 1 is the manual two-step tsls_si1 on the [p10; p60] subsample, and Table 8 column 1 is the two-step tsls_ee1. These two-step point estimates equal weighted 2SLS. The 4 exploratory attempts inspected variable classes and memisc attributes and printed no RESULT lines; attempts 1-3 crashed while printing memisc S4 objects. The first scored run is the final run, and nothing was changed after any comparison with the claims.
